units.source_zh: “呵呵，这么说右府大人也知道了？”

units.source_en: Ieyasu found it strange that Nobunaga, though already informed of the stench, had not grown angry. Perhaps his mind was consumed by the fighting in Bicchu.

ja.t: がせいているのだろう。

units.source_zh: 信长明明已经得知臭气之事，却不生气，对此，家康觉得不可思议，大概信长是正在为备中的战事心急吧。

paragraphs.source_zh: “呵呵，这么说右府大人也知道了？”信长明明已经得知臭气之事，却不生气，对此，家康觉得不可思议，大概信长是正在为备中的战事心急吧。

paragraphs.source_en: At that time, Takigawa Kazumasu was stationed at Mayabashi in the Kanto, while Shibata Katsuie and Sassa Narimasa were besieging Uozu Castle in Etchu. Nobutaka had already reached the port of Sakai and was preparing to cross the sea and attack Awa, while Nobukatsu remained in Ise at the head of his troops. Nobunaga could indeed be said to command a mighty host. Seen in that light, he himself had no choice but to endure...

units.source_en: At that time, Takigawa Kazumasu was stationed at Mayabashi in the Kanto, while Shibata Katsuie and Sassa Narimasa were besieging Uozu Castle in Etchu.
units.source_zh: 此时，泷川一益驻扎在关东的厩桥，柴田胜家和佐佐成政正在越中围攻鱼津城。

units.source_en: Nobutaka had already reached the port of Sakai and was preparing to cross the sea and attack Awa, while Nobukatsu remained in Ise at the head of his troops.
units.source_zh: 信孝已经抵达堺港，正欲渡海进攻阿波，信雄则拥兵驻留伊势。

units.source_en: Nobunaga could indeed be said to command a mighty host.
units.source_zh: 可以说信长手中重兵在握。

units.source_en: Seen in that light, he himself had no choice but to endure...
units.source_zh: 如此看来，自己必须忍耐……

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，泷川一益驻扎在关东的厩桥，柴田胜家和佐佐成政正在越中围攻鱼津城。信孝已经抵达堺港，正欲渡海进攻阿波，信雄则拥兵驻留伊势。可以说信长手中重兵在握。如此看来，自己必须忍耐……

paragraphs.source_en: By the time the stench finally vanished from Azuchi Castle, it was already the morning of the eighteenth, when Nobunaga was to welcome Ieyasu in person. That morning, Ieyasu took more than twenty landed retainers, together with Anayama Baisetsu, and made his way to Soken-ji Temple.

units.source_en: By the time the stench finally vanished from Azuchi Castle, it was already the morning of the eighteenth, when Nobunaga was to welcome Ieyasu in person.
units.source_zh: 臭气终于从安土城消失的时候，已是信长亲自为家康接风洗尘的十八日早上了。

units.source_en: That morning, Ieyasu took more than twenty landed retainers, together with Anayama Baisetsu, and made his way to Soken-ji Temple.
units.source_zh: 是日清晨，家康带了二十多位领有土地的家臣，还带上了穴山梅雪，一起赶赴总见寺。

paragraphs.source_zh: 臭气终于从安土城消失的时候，已是信长亲自为家康接风洗尘的十八日早上了。是日清晨，家康带了二十多位领有土地的家臣，还带上了穴山梅雪，一起赶赴总见寺。

paragraphs.source_en: When Ieyasu and his party reached Soken-ji, Nobunaga was already waiting for them. “Ah, Ieyasu! Welcome, welcome! Today Nobunaga himself shall entertain you.” His face flushed with excitement, he took Ieyasu by the hand and led him to the feast, where he personally served food onto Ieyasu's plate.

units.source_en: When Ieyasu and his party reached Soken-ji, Nobunaga was already waiting for them.
units.source_zh: 家康一行到达总见寺时，信长早已等候在那里。

units.source_en: “Ah, Ieyasu! Welcome, welcome!
units.source_zh: “哦，家康，欢迎欢迎啊！

units.source_en: Today Nobunaga himself shall entertain you.”
units.source_zh: 信长今日要亲自款待你。”

units.source_en: His face flushed with excitement, he took Ieyasu by the hand and led him to the feast, where he personally served food onto Ieyasu's plate.
units.source_zh: 他兴奋得满脸通红，牵着家康的手来到酒席前面，还亲自为家康夹菜。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康一行到达总见寺时，信长早已等候在那里。“哦，家康，欢迎欢迎啊！信长今日要亲自款待你。”他兴奋得满脸通红，牵着家康的手来到酒席前面，还亲自为家康夹菜。

paragraphs.source_en: The lofty keep rising from the mountaintop was magnificent and sumptuous, a breathtaking sight that opened the eyes of Ieyasu and his party. After the tour, when they reached the great hall on the third floor, Nobunaga made a point of giving each of Ieyasu's retainers two unlined robes, saying that one of them was a gift for the retainer's wife. His thoughtfulness was so meticulous as to be almost startling.

units.source_en: The lofty keep rising from the mountaintop was magnificent and sumptuous, a breathtaking sight that opened the eyes of Ieyasu and his party.
units.source_zh: 高高地耸立在山顶的天守阁，豪华壮观，夺人心魄，让家康一行大开眼界。

units.source_en: After the tour, when they reached the great hall on the third floor, Nobunaga made a point of giving each of Ieyasu's retainers two unlined robes, saying that one of them was a gift for the retainer's wife.
units.source_zh: 参观完毕，到了三层的大厅，信长特意给家康的每位家臣分赐了两件单衣，还说其中一件是送给家臣夫人的礼物。

units.source_en: His thoughtfulness was so meticulous as to be almost startling.
units.source_zh: 真是体贴入微，甚至有些让人惊诧。

paragraphs.source_zh: 高高地耸立在山顶的天守阁，豪华壮观，夺人心魄，让家康一行大开眼界。参观完毕，到了三层的大厅，信长特意给家康的每位家臣分赐了两件单衣，还说其中一件是送给家臣夫人的礼物。真是体贴入微，甚至有些让人惊诧。

paragraphs.source_en: The grand festivities continued into the nineteenth. That day's celebration was again held at Soken-ji, and the banquet was every bit as lavish as the day before. After the feast, they watched a Noh performance by Kowaka Hachirokurodayu.

units.source_en: The grand festivities continued into the nineteenth.
units.source_zh: 盛宴一直持续到十九日。

units.source_en: That day's celebration was again held at Soken-ji, and the banquet was every bit as lavish as the day before.
units.source_zh: 这一天仍然是在总见寺，酒宴也和前一天一样豪华。

units.source_en: After the feast, they watched a Noh performance by Kowaka Hachirokurodayu.
units.source_zh: 宴会结束之后，观看了幸若八郎九郎太夫表演的能剧。

paragraphs.source_zh: 盛宴一直持续到十九日。这一天仍然是在总见寺，酒宴也和前一天一样豪华。宴会结束之后，观看了幸若八郎九郎太夫表演的能剧。

paragraphs.source_en: Konoe Sakihisa happened to be there from the capital, so Sakihisa, Nobunaga, and Ieyasu all watched from the honored seats at the front. Konoe Sakihisa seemed adept at reading the room and devoted all his attention to Nobunaga, whereas Ieyasu deliberately played the country bumpkin, taking the utmost care not to stir Nobunaga's suspicions.

units.source_en: Konoe Sakihisa happened to be there from the capital, so Sakihisa, Nobunaga, and Ieyasu all watched from the honored seats at the front.
units.source_zh: 正巧，从京城来的近卫前久也在，于是，前久、信长、家康三人都坐在正面的雅座上观赏。

units.source_en: Konoe Sakihisa seemed adept at reading the room and devoted all his attention to Nobunaga, whereas Ieyasu deliberately played the country bumpkin, taking the utmost care not to stir Nobunaga's suspicions.

ja.t: けているらしく、ひたすら

units.source_zh: 近卫前久似乎擅长察言观色，总是围着信长一个人转，而家康却故意装出一副乡巴佬的样子，尽量不去触碰信长的心智。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正巧，从京城来的近卫前久也在，于是，前久、信长、家康三人都坐在正面的雅座上观赏。近卫前久似乎擅长察言观色，总是围着信长一个人转，而家康却故意装出一副乡巴佬的样子，尽量不去触碰信长的心智。

paragraphs.source_en: The dancing of the Kowaka tayu appeared greatly to Nobunaga's taste. After the second dance-song, “Taishokkan,” was finished, Nobunaga asked, “Well, Ieyasu?”

units.source_en: The dancing of the Kowaka tayu appeared greatly to Nobunaga's taste.
units.source_zh: 幸若太夫的舞蹈似乎很合信长的胃口。

units.source_en: After the second dance-song, “Taishokkan,” was finished, Nobunaga asked, “Well, Ieyasu?”
units.source_zh: 跳完第二支田歌《大织冠》后，信长问道：“怎样，家康？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 幸若太夫的舞蹈似乎很合信长的胃口。跳完第二支田歌《大织冠》后，信长问道：“怎样，家康？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Splendid. I was completely enthralled.” Ieyasu replied.

units.source_en: “Splendid. I was completely enthralled.”
units.source_zh: “不错，我都看得入迷了。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu replied.
units.source_zh: 家康应道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “不错，我都看得入迷了。”家康应道。

paragraphs.source_en: “Good. Bring the tayu here. I shall reward him handsomely.”

units.source_en: “Good. Bring the tayu here.
units.source_zh: “好，把太夫叫来。

units.source_en: I shall reward him handsomely.”
units.source_zh: 我要重重地奖赏。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “好，把太夫叫来。我要重重地奖赏。”

paragraphs.source_en: “You danced well. This is my reward to you.” Nobunaga awarded the tayu ten ingots of gold and laughed heartily.

units.source_en: “You danced well.
units.source_zh: “跳得不错。

units.source_en: This is my reward to you.”
units.source_zh: 这是本座的赏赐。”

units.source_en: Nobunaga awarded the tayu ten ingots of gold and laughed heartily.
units.source_zh: 信长赏给太夫十锭黄金，开怀大笑。

paragraphs.source_zh: “跳得不错。这是本座的赏赐。”信长赏给太夫十锭黄金，开怀大笑。

paragraphs.source_en: As “The Feather Mantle” was nearing its end, a furious roar several times louder than the singing suddenly rang out, startling everyone. “How could he forget again? What is the meaning of this? Bring Umewaka here!”

units.source_en: As “The Feather Mantle” was nearing its end, a furious roar several times louder than the singing suddenly rang out, startling everyone.
units.source_zh: 当《羽衣》快要跳完时，只听见一声怒吼，比歌声都大好几倍，把大家吓了一跳。

units.source_en: “How could he forget again?
units.source_zh: “怎么又忘了？

units.source_zh: 把梅若叫来！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 当《羽衣》快要跳完时，只听见一声怒吼，比歌声都大好几倍，把大家吓了一跳。“怎么又忘了？怎么回事？把梅若叫来！”

paragraphs.source_en: Mori Ranmaru brought the bloodless Umewaka Tayu before Nobunaga. He lacked even the strength to raise his head and lay flattened on the ground like a spider, his whole body trembling violently with fear.

units.source_en: Mori Ranmaru brought the bloodless Umewaka Tayu before Nobunaga. He lacked even the strength to raise his head and lay flattened on the ground like a spider, his whole body trembling violently with fear.
units.source_zh: 面无血色的梅若太夫被森兰丸带到信长面前，连抬头的力气都没有了，如同一只蜘蛛趴在地上，吓得浑身筛糠。

paragraphs.source_zh: 面无血色的梅若太夫被森兰丸带到信长面前，连抬头的力气都没有了，如同一只蜘蛛趴在地上，吓得浑身筛糠。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu could not help breathing a sigh of relief. Nobunaga's roar had made Konoe Sakihisa flinch. Ieyasu could hear that this was no longer the voice of the Minister of the Right...

units.source_en: Ieyasu could not help breathing a sigh of relief.
units.source_zh: 家康不由松了一口气。

units.source_zh: 信长刚才的怒吼，吓得近卫前久一个哆嗦。

units.source_en: Ieyasu could hear that this was no longer the voice of the Minister of the Right...
units.source_zh: 家康听得出，这已不是右大臣的声音了……

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康不由松了一口气。信长刚才的怒吼，吓得近卫前久一个哆嗦。家康听得出，这已不是右大臣的声音了……

paragraphs.source_en: “Ieyasu, you are as fond of Noh as ever—to think that you even rewarded Umewaka...”

units.source_en: “Ieyasu, you are as fond of Noh as ever—to think that you even rewarded Umewaka...”
units.source_zh: “家康，你还是这么喜欢能剧，居然连梅若都奖赏……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “家康，你还是这么喜欢能剧，居然连梅若都奖赏……”

paragraphs.source_en: “But I thought it was quite good. I seldom have the chance to see even dancing of that sort, so...” Ieyasu said.

units.source_en: “But I thought it was quite good. I seldom have the chance to see even dancing of that sort, so...” Ieyasu said.

paragraphs.source_en: The festivities held for Ieyasu lasted three full days, from the eighteenth through the twentieth.

units.source_en: The festivities held for Ieyasu lasted three full days, from the eighteenth through the twentieth.
units.source_zh: 为家康举行的盛宴从十八日到二十日，一共持续了三天。

paragraphs.source_zh: 为家康举行的盛宴从十八日到二十日，一共持续了三天。

paragraphs.source_en: In the end, lacking sufficient troops, Nobunaga reluctantly recalled his eldest son Nobutada from Kofu and ordered him to campaign in the Chugoku region as well. While waiting for Nobutada, Nobunaga seemed to develop a feeling of deep reluctance to part from Ieyasu.

units.source_en: In the end, lacking sufficient troops, Nobunaga reluctantly recalled his eldest son Nobutada from Kofu and ordered him to campaign in the Chugoku region as well.
units.source_zh: 最终，由于兵力不足，信长只得无奈地把甲府的长子信忠召回，让他也出征中国地区。

units.source_en: While waiting for Nobutada, Nobunaga seemed to develop a feeling of deep reluctance to part from Ieyasu.

units.source_zh: 等待信忠的时候，信长似乎产生了一种和家康难舍难离的感情。

paragraphs.source_zh: 最终，由于兵力不足，信长只得无奈地把甲府的长子信忠召回，让他也出征中国地区。等待信忠的时候，信长似乎产生了一种和家康难舍难离的感情。

paragraphs.source_en: On the twentieth, the banquet moved to Koun-ji Temple. Nobunaga continued speaking with Ieyasu in a light, joking tone and personally served him food. “Ieyasu, I wonder whether you and I shall ever again have days like these, when we can speak heart to heart!”

units.source_en: On the twentieth, the banquet moved to Koun-ji Temple. Nobunaga continued speaking with Ieyasu in a light, joking tone and personally served him food.
units.source_zh: 二十日，盛宴地点换成了高云寺，信长仍然以说笑的语气和家康交谈，亲自给他夹菜。

units.source_en: “Ieyasu, I wonder whether you and I shall ever again have days like these, when we can speak heart to heart!”

ja.t: 、このようにおぬしとわしが

units.source_zh: “家康，像这样你我二人倾心相交的日子，不知以后还有否！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 二十日，盛宴地点换成了高云寺，信长仍然以说笑的语气和家康交谈，亲自给他夹菜。“家康，像这样你我二人倾心相交的日子，不知以后还有否！”

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, Ieyasu kept warning himself not to fall into the other man's trap. If he happened to laugh aloud, it might bring about a terrible disaster.

paragraphs.source_zh: 这时，家康心里不断告诫自己，千万不要中了对方的圈套，万一笑出声来，说不定会酿成大祸。

paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Nobunaga, you must not speak so. The realm will soon be pacified. So that we may feast together again in the capital, Ieyasu shall serve you with all the devotion of a hound or horse.”

units.source_en: “Lord Nobunaga, you must not speak so.
units.source_zh: “信长公说的哪里话。

units.source_en: The realm will soon be pacified. So that we may feast together again in the capital, Ieyasu shall serve you with all the devotion of a hound or horse.”
units.source_zh: 天下即将平定，为了能在京城再行盛宴，家康愿效犬马之劳。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “信长公说的哪里话。天下即将平定，为了能在京城再行盛宴，家康愿效犬马之劳。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ieyasu is truly overwhelmed by your favor.”

units.source_en: “Ieyasu is truly overwhelmed by your favor.”
units.source_zh: “家康实诚惶诚恐。”
